newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BANKERS SEE 19.5 PCT INFLATION AT YR-END.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BANKERS SEE 19.5 PCT INFLATION AT YR-END.

text.p: Polish bankers expect year-on- year inflation in December at its current reading of 19.5 percent, a forecast unchanged from last month, a poll by the private Pentor institute showed.
In November the 202 polled bank managers expected the dollar to end the year at 2.87 zlotys, up from its current 2.80 and from the 2.82 bankers forecasted last month.
They also expected the lombard rate to end the year at 24.7 percent, down from its current 25 percent.
The Pentor survey is commissioned monthly by the Polish Banking Association (ZBP).
